metadata.description: /ship — take a feature from idea to merged in one command. Two gates, auto-opening cards, gate notifications, a stage-aware status line, supervised builds, and fresh-agent verification.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: /ship — idea to merged in one command: worktree, discover, plan, build, review, test, land, stopping only where Pete's taste or a risky merge is in play. HTML storyboard (live mockups), plan card and review card in background Chrome tabs, gate notifications and buttons, a stage-aware status line. Opus 5.5 builds; Muse Wonder and Opus read the plan and branch; ship tests its own work in a browser or simulator and lands on a pass. Bundles verify.
